d:
Chain of Command is an intimate portrait of the war against violent extremism and the people devoting their lives to it. From National Geographic and narrated by actor Chris Evans, the first episode begins with an unprecedented look at the efforts of U.S. and Iraqi military forces to regain control of eastern Mosul — the front lines of the war on extremism.
Chain of Command | S1 E1 "By, With and Through"
